notes: Home Dojo decorations. Every decoration is earned, never bought. source: starter (Sensei's welcome gifts), tower (found in Tower chests), named (a named monster's sticker, given once on the first win; never in chests). Later: trophies from real achievements. place: floor or wall (the top wall). solid: the character can't walk through it. clean: mat (gets scuffed, wiped clean) or rack (weapons get knocked crooked, straightened). shape and color are placeholder looks until the art pack. Tier 1 set (A6, art pack decor-tier1): source random (tinted, colour 1 or the floor's belt colour), class, keeper (first clear of floors 1-3), trophy (Monster Journal), bonus (folding screen, mustTouchWall: its top row sits against the top wall). art names the art pack when it isn't dojo. Earning (packages/sim/src/earning.ts): class pieces in file order at the Blessing; keeper statue N the first time the Floor Keeper is beaten at belt tier N; a trophy on the first defeat of its monster (journalTier = the belt tier its Journal entry belongs to); the folding screen once every journalTier 1 trophy is earned.
dropChance_note: Chance that a chest also holds a surprise decoration (random or tower pool), by room kind. S7 rates, Manager call (decor earning PR).
